page.notes: The index is set in two columns. The left column reads from the top down to the last entry, then the right column. Greek entries "συμβατέ μποροι" and "ξενηλασία" are doubtful in their letters and accents. The Greek in the entry "Spartanorum" is printed in a different face and may be misread. The word "tilib.ftipulat" is uncertain; the prefix may be "inutilib". The signature "Cc 3" is partly obscured. The right-hand column has the printed hyphen in "curatu-rum" at the line end. Several abbreviations are preserved as printed, for example "pr.", "fi.", "fin.", and "Carbilius" with its "§.3.".
